title: wCooldown
description: This plugin will help you create custom cooldowns for commands!
body:
# Welcome to the wCooldown plugin page
With this plugin, you can create a cooldown for any command. You can fully customize cooldowns and messages to fit your needs.

### Plugin Features:
* Create and manage command cooldowns
* Edit time limits for each group
* Full customization of messages and groups
* Display time remaining until the cooldown ends
* Custom placeholders provided by the plugin

### Plugin Commands:
* `/cooldown reload` — Reload the configuration

### Plugin Permissions:
* `wcooldown.admin` — Full access to the plugin
* `wcooldown.bypass.*` — Completely bypass all cooldowns
* `wcooldown.bypass.<section>` — Bypass cooldown for a specific section
* `wcooldown.group.<name>` — Grant specific group permissions

### Placeholders:
* `%command%` — Displays the command that is on cooldown
* `%cooldown%` — Displays the total remaining time
* `%cooldown_seconds%` — Displays remaining time in seconds
* `%cooldown_minutes%` — Displays remaining time in minutes
* `%cooldown_hours%` — Displays remaining time in hours
* `%cooldown_days%` — Displays remaining time in days

### Installation:
1. Download the plugin and place it into the `plugins` folder of your Minecraft server;
2. Restart the server;
3. Enjoy using the plugin!
